findings.motion: Senator Hembree proposed amendment 3094R051.KM.GH to H.3094 (Open Carry with Training Act), replacing SECTION 8 on Section 23-31-520
findings.note: Hembree proposed a Senate amendment to the open carry bill. It lets a county or city temporarily limit lawful open carry on public property only where it has issued a permit for a protest, rally, fair, parade or similar event, limited to that event's area and time, with notice when feasible. Without a prior permit the body may not use that power. Event hosts may bar open carry and must post signs. Local bodies keep power over careless discharge and brandishing and cannot take guns except on arrest.
subjects: carry a gun without a permit
